Some background:

In the HBO show Season 4 Episode 4, bookreaders were shocked to see the Other carry one of Craster's Sons extremely far north (presumably the Land of Always Winter). This son was placed on some crazy altar and the baby was magically turned into an Other.

This was shocking mostly because nothing like this had yet happened in the books. There were hints that this was occurring from Craster's wives, though it was only obvious in retrospect after episode 4.

Gilly:

If it’s a girl, that’s not so bad, she’ll grown in a few years and he’’ marry her. But Nella says its to be a boy, and she’s had six and knows these things. He gives the boys to the gods. Come the white cold, he does and of late it comes more often

Craster's Wife:

The boy’s bothers…Craster’s sons. The white cold's rising out there, crow. I can feel it in my bones. These poor old bones don’t lie. They’ll be here soon, the sons

Further speculation is mostly based around whether this is something the Others can do with all babies or just with Craster's sons in particular.

Thematically, ice is linked with betrayal in the series. In the cold north men and women turn on each other, NW men stab their lord commander, Jon gets stabbed and feels cold, the sword Ice cuts off the head of its owner, etc.

The speculation around Craster being special is that he's the bastard son of a NW man (who broke his vows having a son). People don't trust bastards. Additionally, it's a cycle of betrayal as he (a parent) continually abuses his wives and daughters.

Speculation aside, this reveal was so shocking to Rodrick the Bookreaders because stylistically the narrative of the show is so different from the books. Since the books are shown from POV chapters, this fact could be something that's not revealed until late in the books since it would require a character to travel that far north and witness a baby being converted.

So I started thinking to myself about how we as bookreaders could learn this information.

The Theory:

An obvious choice is that Bran could view it through Weirwood.net, but there may not be many trees that far north. Additionally, it could be bad storytelling if we keep getting these big reveals though the omnipotent-god-child's POV.

There is another way I have thought of.

Since Mel was burning people for kingsblood transfusions, Jon sent Sam, Aemon, and Mance's baby to Oldtown...

This means that Gilly's baby - Craster's Son - is still at the Wall!

My theory is that if/when the Others attack the Wall, a POV character will witness an Other turn the baby. That's how we will learn that information as bookreaders. There is also some foreshadowing of this.

  • The baby is born of incest
  • NW members call it "the abomination"
  • It's bad luck for the Free Folk to name their babies
  • Val calls him "the little monster" or "the monster"
  • Jon calls him "Monster" with a capital M

Considering most of Jon's well intentioned acts so far have horribly backfired, I could see this fitting in as something else that Jon could not forsee. In trying to save innocent lives from a horrible death he accidentally dooms another innocent to a potentially worse fate.

Here's his Wiki page: http://awoiaf.westeros.org/index.php/Monster
